tests.name: Windows Node 24 gate runs the real checks in order before the same revision deploys
manual retire is a boolean defaulting to false and CLI aliases reuse the OSS secrets
the Aliyun CLI download pins v3.5.4 and checks SHA-256 before extraction
Bash syntax for tool installation and production publish
normal uploads workers then index, refreshes only four main URLs and verifies both domains
retire uploads workers then index, refreshes only four main URLs and verifies both domains
CDN refresh-retry uses at most one retry and requires a task ID
CDN id-retry uses at most one retry and requires a task ID
CDN refresh-error uses at most one retry and requires a task ID
CDN missing-task-id uses at most one retry and requires a task ID
stale www worker is polled before the retirement worker verifies
main-domain CDN can take six minutes with two 5s sleeps followed by nine 40s sleeps
post-publish verification rejects www-root-200
post-publish verification rejects www-index-200
post-publish verification rejects www-redirect-302
post-publish verification rejects www-redirect-wrong-location
post-publish verification rejects www-redirect-lost-query
post-publish verification rejects wrong-md5
post-publish verification rejects wrong-mime
post-publish verification rejects worker-cacheable
post-publish verification rejects worker-404
post-publish verification rejects head-error
post-publish verification rejects www-active-worker
post-publish verification rejects www-worker-html
post-publish verification rejects www-worker-redirect
HTTPS origin preflight rejects 304 and blocks CDN refresh
failed worker upload blocks index upload and CDN refresh
